title: [finding] publish-smoke-pack parses the whole `pnpm pack --json` stdout, so any publishable package that declares `prepack` reds both smokes at the pack step (armed, unhit)
body:
立卡门类别 ①(可复现的缺陷,具名落点;`finding`,class a,带 `reach:`)。Filed by skills seat 1 (`session_01RdnZdPZH9ByduzPRWuH9tN`) from the os-dev patch-round report on #22658 (comment 6100393030); the seat read the parsing site and the red run.

**class: a** · **reach:** the two publish smokes — `.github/workflows/os-create-smoke.yml` (job "Scaffold outside the monorepo, install, build", step "Scaffold smoke (packed tarballs, outside the repo)") and the release smoke `scripts/publish-smoke.sh` — both call `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` to pack the publishable population. Measured once with a wrong answer: run 38059253305 on PR #22691 head `3372d78b1` (where `@objectstack/skills` declared `prepack`) failed at that step with `Error: pnpm pack --json returned non-JSON for @objectstack/skills:` followed by `> @objectstack/skills@17.7.0 prepack …`. Reproduced locally with the smoke's step-1 command verbatim (`node scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs DEST`): exit 1, 5,823 bytes on stdout, 0 on stderr, `JSON.parse` fails with `Unexpected token '>'`.

**Landing:** `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` `packOne` (`JSON.parse(stdout)` of `pnpm pack --json --pack-destination DEST`). pnpm writes its lifecycle banner (`> PKG@VERSION prepack PATH`, then the script's command line) and the script's own stdout AHEAD of the JSON document, on stdout, whenever the package declares a `prepack` script — regardless of what that script prints. So the smoke's verdict depends on a lifecycle hook the package author may legitimately declare, not on the tarball.

**Today:** no publishable package declares `prepack` (`@objectstack/console` and `@objectstack/skills` use `prepublishOnly`, which `pnpm pack` never runs) — the trap is armed and unhit. PR #22691 moved its own check off `prepack` for exactly this reason (the measurement is in `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`'s header).

**动手的读者:** one `domain:devx` dev (a `scripts/` code-quality gate by the anchor rule), one PR on `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs`: parse the LAST JSON document on stdout (the banner precedes it) or measure which pnpm flag keeps the banner off stdout (`--loglevel silent` / `--ignore-scripts` — `--ignore-scripts` changes what is packed and is ⛔ unless measured equal), and pin it with a self-test fixture whose fake `pnpm` prints a banner line and then the JSON. ⛔ No change to what the smokes judge; ⛔ no exclusion of any package from the publishable population.

**查重:** `search_issues` "publish-smoke-pack pnpm pack --json non-JSON prepack lifecycle banner scaffold smoke pack step" over objectstack-ai/objectstack → 7 hits (open + closed), none this defect; the nearest is #11253 (closed; the pin table derived from the publishable set, the same script, a different defect). Dedupe words: publish-smoke-pack prepack non-JSON · pnpm pack --json lifecycle banner · create-scaffold-smoke pack step.

**Priority reading (the seat's, for triage):** p3 — no current victim; the next package that declares `prepack` finds it at its first PR, in CI, loudly.
